subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should maintainers sponsor a rebase of this Tailscale onboarding chooser onto the current iOS onboarding and gateway registry model, or treat the current main onboarding/Tailnet work as sufficient?
rationale: The submitted behavior is useful and proven, but the branch is conflicted against current main and changes security-sensitive first-run gateway transport choices, so automation cannot decide the product/security direction or conflict-resolution shape safely.

options.title: Rebase The Tailscale Chooser
options.body: Preserve the current gateway registry, staged setup-link, manualTransportPresentation, and branded onboarding UI while porting only the useful chooser/raw-IP/auth-copy behavior.

options.title: Narrow The PR
options.body: Ask the author to keep only the password-specific recovery copy or tests if maintainers do not want a new first-screen connection chooser.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Current Main
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98868 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100317 are considered the accepted onboarding direction, close this PR without landing the stale branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase The Tailscale Chooser
recommendation.body: Preserve the current gateway registry, staged setup-link, manualTransportPresentation, and branded onboarding UI while porting only the useful chooser/raw-IP/auth-copy behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the lead maintainer in CONTRIBUTING.md and recently merged the overlapping Tailnet route/security work.
